 David Hoffman USA TODAY Nov. 4, 2026, 5:12 p.m. ET Hear this story The Savannah Bananas 2027 schedule just released, with tickets available now.
 This article details how to buy tickets to most Bananas games in 2027.
 While Banana Ball may be done for the season, the 2027 season isn't too far away as the Savannah Bananas will head back out on tour starting in February.
 The Harlem Globetrotter-like take on baseball has become a smash hit all across the country, and the team's schedule was recently released.
 SHOP: Savannah Bananas 2027 tickets 
 From the season opener in Auburn, Ala. (Feb. 27) to their regular season finale in San Antonio (Sept. 11) , there's no shortage of games to see the team play in 2027.
 Whether you're a full on fanatic or curious about what Banana Ball is all about, tickets for nearly every game in 2027 are available now , and selling fast. Check out the schedule below and start making plans!
